Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. Recognized as an approved employer by esteemed organizations like ACCA, HKICPA, CIMA, CPA Australia, and CA, and certified accredited trainer with the Singapore Accountancy Commission, we provide comprehensive resources and guidance to ensure our employees remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving finance landscape. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced hire, we empower you to acquire and maintain professional qualifications, enhancing your credibility and competence in the finance domain while keeping you competitive in the ever-changing industry.

What the Role Entails
Job SummaryTencent Finance is seeking an experienced Technical Architect (Finance IT Systems) to define, govern, and evolve the architecture of enterprise finance platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring that finance IT systems are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with business and regulatory requirements. The Senior Technical Architect will work closely with Finance stakeholders to design end-to-end technical solutions covering core finance platforms, integrations, data, and controls.
ResponsibilitiesDesign end-to-end solutions for Finance IT systems (ERP systems, billing, reporting, integrations, data and security etc)
Lead product discovery, design and validate end-to-end finance workflows (e.g. month-end close, billing, approvals, reporting)
Translate complex business needs (e.g., accounting standards, tax regulations, compliance, risk management) into system requirements and drive technical solutions. 
Lead the technical implementations with cross-functional development team to ensure quality and timely project delivery
Provide technical leadership and architecture guidance across delivery teams
Support vendor evaluation, system selection, and solution implementation
Drive modernisation and continuous improvement of finance platforms

Who We Look For
QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
10+ years of IT experience, with 5+ years in a solution or architect role
Solid foundation in computer science fundamentals, including data structures & algorithms, networking, operating systems, and concurrency.
Familiar with mainstream Java backend frameworks (e.g., Spring ecosystem such as Spring MVC / Spring Boot, MyBatis); strong understanding of underlying principles and best practices is a plus.
Strong SQL skills; proficient with mainstream databases such as Oracle and MySQL; experienced in data modeling and database scaling design (sharding / partitioning).
Hands-on experience with large-scale distributed systems and microservices architecture; strong understanding of service governance; practical experience with Dubbo and/or Spring Cloud is preferred.
Proficient in business-level English and Chinese Mandarin in order to work with a vast pool of internal stakeholders based out of China and various international markets. 
Strong analytical skills, business acumen, and ability to influence cross-functional teams. 

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky
